# netbird_agent_network_policy (Data Source)

Read an Agent Network policy by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbird_agent_network_policy" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering → OpenAI"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Policy ID
- `name` (String) Display name for the policy

### Read-Only

- `budget_limit` (Attributes) Per-policy USD spend cap (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budget_limit))
- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description
- `destination_provider_ids` (List of String) Agent Network provider IDs the source groups can reach
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled
- `guardrail_ids` (List of String) Agent Network guardrail IDs attached to this policy
- `source_groups` (List of String) NetBird group IDs whose members may call the destination providers
- `token_limit` (Attributes) Per-policy token cap (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_limit))

<a id="nestedatt--budget_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budget_limit`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `group_cap_usd` (Number)
- `user_cap_usd` (Number)
- `window_seconds` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--token_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_limit`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `group_cap` (Number)
- `user_cap` (Number)
- `window_seconds` (Number)
